title: loquor agent profile
description: One device: who it is (name, description), what it measures (sensors), what it can do (triggers) and, if it thinks, its brain. No brain = a node: no LLM, it shares its sensors and triggers with agents in range. Device-level choices (transport, model) belong in ~/.loquor/config.json; the profile may still pin them.

name.description: Human-readable name. Also names the key file and the log label.

description.description: One sentence other agents' LLMs read to decide whether you can help them.

system_prompt.description: Default prompt for every skill that takes one (the brain's "prompt" wins). Usually set in brain instead.

system_prompt_file.description: Read system_prompt from this text file (path relative to the profile).

visibility.description: visible: beacon and answer. quiet: never beacon, but answer. silent: only initiate.

beacon_interval.description: Seconds between beacons. Lower = faster discovery, more radio traffic. Default: device config, else 10.

key_file.description: Ed25519 seed file. Default ~/.loquor/keys/<name>.key, created on first run.

relay.description: Store and forward envelopes for peers out of each other's reach.

transport.description: Pin a transport: {"type": "localhost" | "wifi" | "bluetooth" | "module:Class"}. Usually left out so the device config decides.

reasoner.description: {"type": "ollama" | "openai" | "template" | "none" | "module:Class", ...}. Usually left out: the device config picks the backend and model, and a profile without a brain gets "none".

sensors.description: What it measures. Built-ins: simulated, command, file, http, gpio, serial; or "file.py:function_or_Class". Each needs a unique name.

triggers.description: What it can do. Built-ins: console, command, file, http, gpio, serial; or "file.py:function_or_Class". Each needs a unique name and a description the LLM reads.

brain.description: How this device thinks. Present = an agent with an LLM; absent = a node without one.

prompt.description: How the LLM behaves: persona and rules. {sensors} is replaced by the current readings (else they are appended).

prompt_file.description: Read prompt from this text file (path relative to the profile).

goal.description: What to achieve. With a goal the brain reads what it needs, asks agents that can help, and may act. Without, it only answers questions.

every.description: Pursue the goal every N seconds. Left out: once, when enough peers are in range.

act.description: Triggers the brain may fire: own names and nodes' ("tank-node:valve"). Left out: every trigger it can reach; []: never act.

sensors.description: Sensors to read: own, and peers' ("soil-node:soil_moisture"). Left out: its own and those of every node in range (not other agents': those it asks).

peers.description: Only use these peers (names). Left out: all in range.

ask_agents.description: Ask other agents (peers with an LLM) for help with the goal.

min_peers.description: Think once this many peers have shared data or answered. Default 1 (0 with every and own sensors).

settle.description: Or think this many seconds after the last new peer, if fewer than min_peers turn up.

temperature.description: 0 for steady decisions, 0.2-0.4 for varied prose.

description.description: What other agents read about the question capability.

share.description: What this device lets agents in range use. Default: sensors always; triggers only on a node (no brain). false = nothing.

min_trust.description: 0: any agent in range. 1: only agents whose key is pinned (~/.loquor/pinned_keys.json).

skills.description: Skills added by hand, for behaviour brain and share do not cover. Built-ins: brain, llm_answer, goal, collect, sensor_report, offer_triggers.

type.description: A built-in name, "module:Class" for an installed module, or "file.py:Class" / "file.py:function" for a file next to the profile. Every other key is passed to the constructor.

system_prompt_file.description: For skills: read system_prompt from this text file (path relative to the profile).
